Continue failed-run containment and repair-or-close review without requeue. Require canonical lineage, deduplication identity, ownership, root cause, smallest isolated repair, focused validation, rollback, and explicit requeue-or-close disposition before implementation resumes.

Keep private launch gates unchanged. Continue bounded read-only rights, data-flow, retention, consent, vendor, incident, accuracy, and security evidence work; preserve unknown controls as unknown and keep external permission requests unsent pending owner and human-counsel authorization.
